top_signal.title: How much of your week do you spend on tasks you could hand off? I tracked mine and was shocked
top_signal.summary: Did a quick time audit this week — logged every 30-minute block for 5 days. Turns out about 35% of my time was going toward things like fielding inquiries, chasing documents, scheduling, and onboarding follow-ups. None of it bad work, just not revenue-generating work.   Started thinking about it as a staffing problem: if I had a small ops team, I'd have one person on inbound inquiries, one on paperwork and records, one on calendar and follow-ups. The business actually needs those roles — I just can't justify staffing all three.   Has anyone found a good solution for this? I've been experimenting with AI agents to automate some of these slots and it's helped, but curious what approaches others have taken. Do you delegate to part-timers, use automation tools, or just accept that it's part of running a lean operation?       submitted by     /u/bailbondslocal       [link]       [comments]
